permissions.name: User.Read.All
permissions.justification: Search enabled internal Entra member accounts and revalidate a selected account before adding it to a branch group.

permissions.name: GroupMember.ReadWrite.All
permissions.justification: Idempotently read and change ordinary membership in the existing branch Microsoft 365 group.

permissions.name: Group.ReadWrite.All
permissions.justification: Create a Team only for an existing approved branch group that does not yet have one.

permissions.name: Team.ReadBasic.All
permissions.justification: Read only the basic Team identity to reconcile existing Teams without creating duplicates.

permissions.name: Schedule.ReadWrite.All
permissions.justification: Read and initialize the native Shifts schedule for an explicitly configured branch Team.
